records.name: harewood
records.finding: The complete route uses 82 edge anchors from the pinned 2019 intensity raster. Starting limits follow neighbouring visible road lines across the paved entrance; the right edge at building entrances around stations 324 and 336 interpolates between neighbouring observations. The widened final paved bay is retained. Satellite context and the 2015 intensity cloud were supporting visual checks, not terrain updates. Unverified estimated borders, metre-scale source pixels and sparse interpolation limit accuracy.

records.name: gurston
records.finding: The full saved open route uses 66 sparse road-limit controls from the 2019 last-return intensity raster. The paved strip is separated from adjoining fields, hedges and farm roofs; exact hedge-side verge positions remain uncertain at metre-scale raster resolution. Two right-side intervals at stations 60 and 210 interpolate between neighbouring observations where vegetation or the side opening obscures the edge. The entrance follows adjoining visible road directions and excludes the roof. Original trace, timing and terrain are retained. Unverified estimates, sparse interpolation and illustrative curbs remain explicit.

records.name: shelsley
records.finding: The start selection has been corrected using pinned one-way raceway nodes and an independently geolocated west-facing start photograph. Removing a nearly coincident service-way/raceway out-and-back reduces the source route from 1017.1 m to 939.4 m. No coordinates were adjusted to match the operator distance. The sparse source endpoint still lies 38.5 m beyond the supplied finish; timing extent remains provisional. Woodland verges require explicit image measurements; no borders or driving model are added by this correction.
